boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Verify branch and head directly, then use bounded staged and unstaged index-diff checks without repeating the full status scan.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Avoid full status enumeration as the first check on a newly materialized 46000-plus-file checkout.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timeout at zero credit and stop if branch, head, or either diff domain is not attributable.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner worktree verification only; no broader assurance or independent-reproduction credit.
preferred_methods.title: Bound inherited-checkout verification
trigger_preconditions: A newly materialized inherited worktree requires source, branch, and clean-diff verification.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Wrap the complete revision peel expression in single quotes before passing it to git rev-parse.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Quote every revision expression containing caret, braces, colon, or shell-significant punctuation.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the fatal probe and use the already attributable plain head only if the peeled form cannot be verified.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Git argument quoting only; no repository mutation or authority credit.
preferred_methods.title: Quote Git revision peel expressions in PowerShell
trigger_preconditions: PowerShell passes a Git revision containing caret and brace syntax.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Count expected dispositions directly from the frozen proposal table and fail before writing if the declared aggregate differs.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never change proposal evidence labels to satisfy a preferred distribution; derive the distribution from proposal truth.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed generator attempt and write no packet until the aggregate matches the frozen table.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Preregistration accounting only; no x2 or empirical credit.
preferred_methods.title: Derive proposal outcome totals from frozen specifications
trigger_preconditions: A proposal table and declared aggregate are authored separately.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Preserve the authoritative live request and failed audit, then validate only immediate route structure through a marked compatibility projection that carries the live overrides explicitly.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Never present a compatibility projection as validation of the newer policy values.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed audit and stop route execution if the immediate ownership projection also fails.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: The passing projection validates immediate route structure only, not the expanded caps.
preferred_methods.title: Separate live policy overrides from legacy workflow-runner route validation
trigger_preconditions: A newer live request expands policy caps beyond the installed workflow runner's encoded values.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the state returned by the witness command and transition directly from validated to preferred only once.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Do not hard-code a second validated transition after a passing witness.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the rejected transition and resume from the ledger's actual valid state without rebuilding the ledger.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Method Flow state handling only; no broader evidence credit.
preferred_methods.title: Respect Method Flow witness auto-promotion
trigger_preconditions: The Method Flow runner records a passing witness for a candidate method.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Set PYTHONUTF8=1 for the skill validator on Windows before reading UTF-8 skill documents.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Declare UTF-8 for Python subprocesses that read skill packages on Windows; do not strip or transliterate valid text to satisfy a legacy codec.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed validation at zero credit and stop if explicit UTF-8 still cannot read the package.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Windows skill-package decoding only; no broader validation or authority credit.
preferred_methods.title: Declare UTF-8 for Windows skill validation
trigger_preconditions: A Python validator reads UTF-8 GHC skill text on Windows.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Give every skill package an explicit Boundaries heading even when equivalent constraints already appear under a specialized heading.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Validate shared structural headings across both generated and hand-authored packages before the aggregate.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed aggregate and remove only the additive heading if it introduces a contradiction.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Skill documentation structure only; no broader capability or authority credit.
preferred_methods.title: Keep a uniform explicit Boundaries section in every skill
trigger_preconditions: Generated and hand-authored skills share one structural contract.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the current Method Flow summary keys and consume preferred_methods with its published field names.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect generated JSON keys and one representative row before binding a closeout builder to the summary schema.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed builder attempt at zero credit and remove any partial closeout output before retrying; no partial files were written in this instance.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Method Flow summary consumption only; no broader closeout or authority credit.
preferred_methods.title: Bind closeout builders to the current Method Flow summary schema
trigger_preconditions: A closeout builder reads a generated Method Flow summary.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Pass each reflection focus term with its own --focus argument because the runner uses an append action.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect argparse action and confirm scoped_count is nonzero before crediting a focused reflection run.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the zero-scoped output at zero credit and overwrite only the additive reflection output with a correctly focused run.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Reflection-Remaster focus selection only; no broader tool-quality or authority credit.
preferred_methods.title: Repeat Reflection-Remaster focus arguments
trigger_preconditions: The reflection runner accepts --focus with argparse append semantics.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use Select-String with literal paths and separately quoted patterns when inspecting PowerShell source text.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Prefer literal-path PowerShell cmdlets for short source probes containing nested quote syntax.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the parser error at zero credit and issue no mutation before a quote-safe read succeeds.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: One read-only PowerShell source inspection only.
preferred_methods.title: Use literal-path Select-String for quote-sensitive PowerShell probes
trigger_preconditions: A short PowerShell source probe contains nested quote characters.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use raw JavaScript template literals or explicitly doubled backslashes for every Windows command and workdir path passed through an orchestration wrapper.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Construct Windows command and workdir strings with String.raw before dispatch and verify the resolved D-first directory read-only.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain each wrapper rejection at zero credit and leave the staged index untouched until a raw-path probe succeeds.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Windows path transport through the local orchestration wrapper only.
preferred_methods.title: Preserve Windows paths through raw wrapper literals
trigger_preconditions: A JavaScript wrapper sends a Windows path containing backslashes to PowerShell or the shell workdir field.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run repository-scoped Git probes from the resolved owned worktree, not from the configuration directory.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Resolve the owned worktree first, then bind every repository-scoped Git probe to that workdir.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the failed read at zero credit and perform no mutation before a worktree-bound Git probe passes.
preferred_methods.title: Bind Git probes to the resolved owned worktree
trigger_preconditions: A Git command depends on repository discovery and the current wrapper directory may be outside the repository.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the runner's top-level help first and invoke only its accepted record, witness, set-state, validate, and summarize surfaces.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Capture the accepted command list from top-level help before requesting subcommand help.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain each parser refusal at zero credit and do not edit the ledger directly.
preferred_methods.title: Discover the Method Flow command surface before invocation
trigger_preconditions: A caller has not verified the current Method Flow runner subcommand names.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Pass fixed directories to ripgrep and express filename selection with one or more -g filters on Windows.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use positional directory roots plus ripgrep glob filters instead of wildcard positional paths.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the refused scan at zero credit and do not infer absence until the corrected directory-scoped scan passes.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only Windows ripgrep file selection only.
preferred_methods.title: Use ripgrep glob filters for Windows filename selection
trigger_preconditions: A Windows ripgrep scan must select filename families across fixed repository directories.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Before generating self-excluding staged manifests, remove only the declared receipt paths from the index and assert their staged intersection is empty.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Stage intended inputs, unstage only declared self-excluding outputs, assert zero staged intersections, then generate and restage the receipts.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the refused generator at zero credit and leave working-tree receipt content available until the exact index contract is restored.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Additive staged-manifest receipt generation only; no history rewrite or working-tree deletion.
preferred_methods.title: Honor staged-manifest self-exclusion before generation
trigger_preconditions: A staged-review generator declares its own output receipts as index self-exclusions.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve phase artifacts as REPO / PHASE_ROOT / relative_path inside the final-review script.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Reuse only path constants declared by the script and exercise new path expressions in an isolated read before the generator.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the NameError at zero credit and do not stage any incomplete receipt output.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Two repository-relative document reads in the owner-local final-review script only.
preferred_methods.title: Resolve final-review documents from declared path constants
trigger_preconditions: A final-review script adds a new repository-relative artifact read.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use LiteralPath PowerShell reads for simple Windows word-count witnesses instead of quote-dense inline Python.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Prefer a checked-in script or LiteralPath cmdlets whenever an inline program contains nested path-string quoting.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the inline-program failure at zero credit and do not infer file readability from the failed expression.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Two owner-local text-file word counts only.
preferred_methods.title: Avoid quote-dense inline Python for Windows path witnesses
trigger_preconditions: A read-only Windows witness would require nested path strings inside an inline Python argument.
